scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Exact criterion for diagonal single-Kraus heralding between two generalized-amplitude-damping steps, plus a rational channel for which every intermediate unitary is entanglement breaking but one selective intermediate outcome preserves entanglement.
scientific_integrity.evidence: Analytic Choi/PPT derivation and exact polynomial Bernstein positivity certificate; verify.py reproduces the rational identities.
limitations: Selected Kraus outcome is trace-nonincreasing, not a deterministic CPTP filter.
No counterexample to the conjecture about deterministic CPTP filters is claimed.
All-unitary obstruction certified at a rational channel and by continuity nearby, not globally.
No optimization over arbitrary non-diagonal probabilistic branches or deterministic nonunitary filters.
scientific_integrity.originality_caveat: Search and inspected literature do not establish global uniqueness, and a differently phrased equivalent specialization may be unindexed.

title: Heralded versus unitary protection under thermal qubit damping
